body:
Adds `research/fusion-twin`: a twin that draws redundant-sensor errors independently vs real errors with pairwise correlation ρ. Exact equicorrelated fused variance, n_eff < 1/ρ, sensor-count floor and cliff (16 vs 30 at ρ=0.03, infeasible at ρ≥0.0625), gate false alarms (8.6× at ρ=0.05), and a mixed repair result (plug-in misses target ~half the time; bootstrap upper bound costs ~2× sensors).

Also updates README.md and site/projects.json; `python site/build.py` prints ok (148 projects); 9 unit tests pass.
